# EngineDivergingBarChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasEngineDivergingBarChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineDivergingBarChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineDivergingBarChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineDivergingBarChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartEngineElement`](UltraCanvasChartEngineElement.md) → [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Any of the charts above **on the chart engine** — themes, measured layout, solved labels, tooltips, Vertical / Horizontal / Polar — compared with the legacy ones on the demo's *Chart Engine Comparison* page (`UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md`)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasEngineCharts](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasEngineDivergingBarChart> CreateEngineDivergingBarChart( const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasEngineDivergingBarChart(const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `DivergingBarStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Likert` |  |
| `PopulationPyramid` |  |
| `Tornado` |  |
| `OpposingBars` |  |

### enum `DivergingSide`

Which side of zero a category's segments grow on. Neutral is split across zero under Likert (SetSplitNeutral) and sits on the negative side otherwise.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Negative` |  |
| `Neutral` |  |
| `Positive` |  |

### struct `DivergingBarCategory`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `std::string name` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)` | alpha 0 = from the palette |
| `side` | `DivergingSide side = DivergingSide::Positive` |  |

### struct `DivergingBarRow`

One row: a value per category, in category order (missing = 0). Values are amounts - the side decides the direction, the sign is ignored.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `values` | `std::vector<double> values` |  |

### struct `DivergingPopulationGroup`

A population pyramid's age group.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` | "0-4", "85-89", "100+" - parsed for average ages |
| `left` | `double left = 0.0` | e.g. males |
| `right` | `double right = 0.0` | e.g. females |

### enum `DivergingRowOrder`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TopDown` | first row at the top (survey questions) |
| `BottomUp` | first row at the bottom (age groups, youngest first) |

### struct `Segment`

One drawn segment in value space.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `row` | `size_t row = 0` |  |
| `category` | `size_t category = SIZE_MAX` | SIZE_MAX = a side total (tornado / opposing) |
| `side` | `int side = 1` | 1 left of zero, +1 right |
| `from` | `double from = 0.0, to = 0.0` | signed value extent |
| `amount` | `double amount = 0.0` | what the segment represents |
| `offset` | `double offset = 0.0` | slot offset (-0.5..0.5) for half-height bars |
| `fill` | `double fill = 1.0` | fraction of the bar thickness |
| `surplus` | `bool surplus = false` |  |
| `color` | `Color color` |  |
